messages.content:
Draft graph.json for this:

Password reset in our web app. The user says they forgot their password and asks the web app for help. The web app looks up their account in the users database. The web app emails a one-time reset link through the email service, which expires after an hour or one use. The email reaches the user. The user opens the link in the app, chooses a new password, and is signed in. Actors: user. Service: web app (inside a "Your app" zone along with the users database). External: email service. Keep the flow in that order.

reply.text: {"graph":{"version":1,"title":"Password reset in our web app","nodes":[{"id":"user","label":"User","kind":"actor","icon":"user"},{"id":"app","label":"Web app","kind":"service","icon":"app-window","zone":"backend"},{"id":"users","label":"Users database","kind":"database","icon":"database","zone":"backend"},{"id":"mailer","label":"Email service","kind":"external","icon":"mail"}],"edges":[{"id":"ask","from":"user","to":"app","label":"Forgot password"},{"id":"lookup","from":"app","to":"users","label":"Find account"},{"id":"send_link","from":"app","to":"mailer","label":"Reset link"},{"id":"deliver","from":"mailer","to":"user","label":"Reset email"},{"id":"open_link","from":"user","to":"app","label":"Open link"},{"id":"set_password","from":"user","to":"app","label":"New password"},{"id":"signed_in","from":"app","to":"user","label":"Signed in"}],"zones":[{"id":"backend","label":"Your app"}]},"assumptions":["The web app is the single service that handles the whole reset, so the user talks only to it.","The reset link is opened in the web app, which then asks for the new password.","The email service is an external provider, not part of your app.","The one-hour and single-use expiry is a rule for the storyboard, not a separate step in the graph.","Signing in is the web app's reply to the user after the new password is set."],"questions":[]}
